snippet.title: Master System Longplay [091] T2 - The Arcade Game
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by MadMatty

I was looking through the games list and noticed this game. never imagined id see this game ported to master system, so have spent the evening playing....and raging.
 
This has to be the most difficult version of the game released. I played on Normal, but damn....without tool assistance I dont think it would be possible to complete the game.
 
Enemies constantly spawning and the hurt so much. The are also no Life/Credit drops! Unfortunatly I didnt get best ending, as it looks like you have to get 100% damage on the cyberdyne stage. other versions let you miss a few.
 
Regarding the port it self I find the gfx very faithful and at least the night stages look like nighttime, unlike the red sky genesis version. -
